review.headline: Easy 9 km completed on target distance, paced at 5:50/km, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band.
observations: Distance 9.01 km against 9.0 km planned, moving time 3150 s, avg pace 5:50/km, all nine km splits even at 350 s.
Pace sits in the middle of the easy band and is close to the prior easy run on 2026-11-05 (5:42/km, avg HR 138), so the effort looks conversational.
Even splits across the full run suggest steady, controlled pacing with no drift.
flags: No heart rate, RPE or athlete note was logged, so effort intensity cannot be confirmed beyond pace.
Training load shows CTL falling from about 43 to 27 with almost no running since 2026-11-07, so fitness is trending down over the coming days.
